text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah! A message from Journey-senpai!
...She finally sent the details about that favor.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ooh, says we're digging holes on some mountain owned by an acquaintance!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: Huh... Digging holes, in the mountains...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. Missed here too~.
Dammit~.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Isn't this super shady after all?
Digging holes out in the mountains screams suspicious!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like I saaaid, you're overthinking it!
...All we're looking for is a box! A box her old man and his buddy buried—

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
That's what's so weird! Would a normal person go this far?
For some box her parents buried in a drunken stupor...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... anyway, let's just dig!
You came here to uncover senpai's 'true nature,' didn't you?
Come on, dig, dig!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next up is here—... wait.
No way someone would bury it in a rocky spot like this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...No. Let us check just to be certain.
There is always the possibility it was done deliberately.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That being said, it is backbreaking work, so I shall handle this area.
Vodka-san, please take the section ahead.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: Phew~ I'm beat. Break time...

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah. J-Journey-senpai...
A-Are you taking a break too?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. My hoe broke, so I came to replace it.
...Please, do not mind me, rest as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...The sun's starting to set on us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It cannot be helped.
Once we finish digging this area, let us wrap up—

(Thunk!)
(Rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Journey-senpai, that sound just now...!
Hold on, I'll dig around it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No.
From here on, by hand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall dig with my hands.
—I would not want to damage it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed.
I had my juniors lend a hand... yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...A reward?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, there is no need.
Knowing that it brought Father joy is more than enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we stop by somewhere? As thanks for today, please allow me to treat you both to a meal.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Wah, sweet! ...Wait, senpai, before that, one question.
In the end, what was inside that box anyway?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah.
—This is it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A baby picture?
...Wait! A-Ah, could this be?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, yes. A photograph taken when my younger sister was born.
...This is my mother, and the girl with short hair is me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even as an infant, her profile is lovely, isn't it?
They said she took after Mother, bringing a rare smile to my stern father's face—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: When it was decided they would bury their 'cherished treasures' in a drunken stupor, it seems Father put this photo inside.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Heheh. That was the first time I had ever seen my taciturn, gruff father looking so utterly heartbroken.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Senpai, you really love your father, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...My father, my mother, and my sister.
I love every member of my family.
After work. Stepping into a nearby restaurant, I ran into Dream Journey and the others.
choice_data_list: Didn't expect to see you at a place like this, Dream Journey.

text_block_list.text:
After work, I headed to a nearby restaurant,
where I ran into Dream Journey and the others.
choice_data_list: Dream Journey, you come to places like this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
We shared blood, sweat, and tears together—the ultimate crew! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
...To be honest, I thought she was a scary senpai at first—total misunderstanding!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh, indeed.
Both of them are juniors I am truly proud of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, totally!
She looks like the type who'd hang out at some quiet, cool place!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I happen to like spots brimming with exotic ambiance.
...It gives you the feeling of traveling, does it not?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, I know a great place!
I'll introduce it to you later!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
I would very much appreciate that.
